rain.station: SILO gridded data at the property (BoM)

site.source: NSW 5 m DEM (DCS Spatial Services, from aerial stereo imagery; downloaded 2026), resampled to the 1 m map grid
site.boundaryNote: Property outline from the NSW cadastre 2026 (property register, about ±1–2 m). The map's lot is the main 33 ha part; the two smaller parts of the same register property, south of the road strip, are drawn as a thin outline.
